title: Checkout can be started and completed to the overview with an empty cart
why: Not filed as a defect: no written requirement says an empty cart must block checkout. Common e-commerce expectation; needs a product-owner decision.

title: Whitespace-only first name passes checkout validation
why: Not filed as a defect: validation rules are not specified. Recommended: trim input before the required-field check.

title: Clicking Sauce Labs Backpack opens the Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket detail page
why: Same root-cause family as the other problem_user defects (product-specific behaviour is broken). Kept as a finding to stay within the 8 reports; would be a Major defect in a real project.

title: Reset App State clears the badge but leaves Remove buttons on the product page until reload
why: Minor UI-state inconsistency. Not filed: the demo app documents Reset App State as a tester helper, not a customer feature.
